newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonian army alerted on Albanian border.
newsitem.headline: Macedonian army alerted on Albanian border.

text.p: Macedonian Defence MInister Blagoja Handziski has ordered the army to increase its combat readiness along the Albanian border, state radio said on Tuesday.
Macedonia fears a wave of refugees and illegal border crossings as a result of the violence in its Balkan neighbour..
The government on Monday advised Macedonian citizens against non-essential travel to Albania and urged Macedonians in Albania to contact the embassy in Tirana.
Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski said cross-border traffic was greatly reduced.
